clues.text: In the Praetorium, Roman soldiers twisted these together and mocked Jesus as King of the Jews.
In Jesus' parable of the sower, some seed fell among these, which grew up and choked the seedlings.
The Teacher of Ecclesiastes says the laughter of a fool is like these crackling under the pot.
After Adam ate the forbidden fruit, God said the cursed ground would yield these along with thistles.
At Bochim, the angel of the LORD warned that the nations left in Canaan would be these in Israel's sides.
Gideon used these and wilderness briers to discipline the elders of Succoth, who had refused his troops bread.
Writing to the Corinthians, Paul says one of these in his flesh, a messenger of Satan, kept him from conceit.
